gestures.title: KinectNavigator - gestures
gestures.body:
WAKING IT UP
Rest your dominant hand near your shoulder for a moment. It sleeps again if your arm just hangs or you dance, so it won't fire mid-routine.

NAVIGATING - a small + centred on your dominant shoulder
  reach out to the side ......... Left / Right
  reach up ...................... Up
  reach down-and-out ........... Down
  hold the reach ............... repeats (speeds up)
  bend the elbow / pull back ... stops

CONFIRM / BACK
  put your OTHER hand on your OTHER shoulder, then:
  reach up or right and hold .... Enter
  reach down or left and hold ... Esc

Stand about 2.5 m back, centred, facing the sensor.
Full details and troubleshooting are in SETUP.md.
